tagline.en_US: Self-hosted email archival and search server that downloads mailboxes over IMAP into encrypted local storage.

description.en_US: Bichon is a self-hosted email archiving server. It downloads messages from IMAP accounts, builds a full-text search index, and provides an embedded web interface for unified cross-account search. The system is designed for long-term email preservation and programmatic access. It functions strictly as an archive and does not send, compose, forward, or reply to emails.
